blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines–Rhenz Abando will no longer play for Gilas Pilipinas in the fifth window of the Fiba World Cup 2027 Asian Qualifiers in Seremban, Malaysia, next week due to an ankle injury. Coach Tim Cone on Friday confirmed Abando’s absence from the two games against Syria and Iran after getting hurt during a recent game for Anyang Jung Kwan Jang in the Korean Basketball League.
